title: Exact derived realization of a Cartier class with canonical source and target comparisons
statement: Let $C,D$ be abelian categories with specified derived categories, let $C$ have K-injective resolutions, and let $F:C\to D$ be additive and preserve finite limits and finite colimits. Use the degree-zero embedding $[-][0]$ and degree-two Ext realization in the derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For $X\in C$, $Y\in D$, $Z\in D(C)$, $W\in D(D)$, specified isomorphisms $s:Z\cong X[0]$, $t:W\cong Y[0][2]$, and $c\in\operatorname{Ext}^2_D(FX,Y)$, define compatibility of an arrow $\delta:RF(Z)\to W$ with $c$ to mean $\delta=RF(s)\,;\epsilon_{F,X}\,;c\,;t^{-1}$. Here $\epsilon_{F,X}:RF(X[0])\cong(FX)[0]$ is the canonical exact-direct-image/single-object comparison, and $\epsilon_{F,X};c$ is exactly the existing supported exact derived realization [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-system]. The interface may express this as heterogeneous equality to avoid re-elaborating identical endpoints; applied to the displayed Hom type this is ordinary equality. For a commutative ring $A$ in universe $u+1$ and a scheme $T$ in universe $u$, use the ordinary pro-etale coefficient objects of [def-sp-p1-comparison-arrows], and define the canonical constant-source comparison $\nu_T^*(A_{T,et}[0])\cong A_{T,proet}[0]$ to be comparison with the degree-zero embedding followed by the constant-sheaf comparison of [sk-lem-geo-cartier]. Also define, for any exact additive $G:C\to D$ and $L\in C$, the isomorphism $D(G)(L[0][2])\cong G(L)[0][2]$ to be canonical shift commutation followed by the degree-zero comparison. For any $N\in\mathbf N$ with $NA=0$, applying this last construction to $G=\nu_T^*$ and the actual finite Tate line [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-sheaf] gives the target comparison. No class, arrow, or unspecified source or target isomorphism is chosen, and no existence theorem is asserted.
